Ferroelectric AlScN thin films by reactive sputtering

Abstract

AlScN thin films were deposited by reactive magnetron sputtering.

Experimental

AlScN films were deposited on Si(100) by reactive magnetron sputtering.

The target power was 200 W and the working pressure was 0.5 Pa. Ar flow was 20 sccm and N2 flow was 5 sccm.

Table 1. Deposition conditions.
Power200 W
Pressure0.5 Pa

See the Supplementary Information for details.

Results and Discussion

The AlScN films were ferroelectric and piezoelectric.
